stances.summary: Opposes bill combining insider trading ban with voter suppression measures
stances.quote:
Republicans are trying to pull a trick this week.

They say we are voting on an “insider trading” bill, but have snuck in massive SAVE Act-style voter suppression measures to it.

This is a GOP effort to sabotage national mail-in voting, disguised as a trading ban.

I’m voting NO

stances.summary: Accuses GOP of sabotaging insider trading ban with voter suppression rider
stances.quote:
If GOP were at all serious about the insider trading issue, they would put it up on its own for a vote. 

They know adding voter suppression to it will sabotage the effort to ban insider trading. 

That’s exactly why they’re doing it this way. Don’t fall for it. Spread the word.

stances.summary: Proposes legislation to ban gifts to Supreme Court justices, citing corruption concerns
stances.quote:
The Supreme Court is facing a major corruption crisis.

I'm proud to introduce the High Court Gift Ban Act, with @RepRaskin and @SenatorLujan, to remove the influence of dark money from our nation’s highest judicial body.

We must safeguard the sanctity of our democracy.
